vlae.blok: Wat die lae vir ons sê
vlae.teks: Waar die lae nog netjies op mekaar lê, is 'n fossiel wat laer af lê, ook vroeër toegemaak.
vlae.rede: The comparison 'vroeër' has no stated second term (earlier than a fossil higher up), and 'ook' leans on the layer sentence before it; a Grade 5 reader may stumble. Making it explicit would add words to a claim, so it is left for the writer to judge rather than changed here.
